projects.title: Keybright Keyboard
projects.description: The Keybright Keyboard was my senior design project in college. The project involved the creation of a keyboard with LCD keys. Each key could be programmed to simulate either a regular keypress or a series of keypresses (macro). Additionally, users have the capability to provide custom images on each key according to individual profiles. I worked on the software that allows the user to interact and program the keys in whatever way they desire.
